summary: Iteration 14 — Backend + Frontend E2E for (1) Home hero carousel + admin CRUD, (2) external_booking_url on tours, (3) CatalogPanel race regression. Backend: 8/8 pytest passing (public /home-slides sorted, admin list/create/update/delete, route-shadow check, tour external_booking_url PUT persist + public expose). Frontend E2E: hero carousel works (7 dots, prev/next changes background, title suffix 'On your terms.' always present, subtitle mirrors slide), /tours external link renders only when set (href=https://www.bluelagoonisland.com/, target=_blank, rel=noopener noreferrer), /admin/manage 'Home Slides' tab renders panel with 7 slides + Add + up/down chevrons + edit/delete controls, CatalogPanel race fix confirmed (rapid /admin/manage → Rentals no longer shows tours items), /rentals still renders (promo strike regression path OK). One HIGH frontend gap: the EditModal.jsx form does NOT render an input for external_booking_url — the state field + payload wiring exist (lines 29 & 63), but no <F l=... testid='edit-external-url' /> element is present in the JSX between lines 100-107, so admins have no UI to set the URL. Reproducible: /admin/manage → Tours → Edit any tour → modal has Name/Description/Price/Category/Duration/Location/ImageURL/Active/Featured but NO 'Official booking URL' field.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing UI input for 'Official booking URL'. State (form.external_booking_url) and save payload wiring exist, but no <F> field is rendered — admins cannot set/clear the external_booking_url from the UI. Add a field similar to Location, e.g. `!isRental && !isTaxi && <F l="Official booking URL" v={form.external_booking_url} on={(v)=>setForm({...form, external_booking_url:v})} testid="edit-external-url" />`, ideally as a full-width row below the 2-col grid.

action_items: Add the missing 'Official booking URL' input to EditModal.jsx tours branch — must expose data-testid='edit-external-url' bound to form.external_booking_url. Only render when kind === 'tours' (i.e. `!isRental && !isTaxi`).

Consider extending EditModal payload to always send external_booking_url (including empty→null) so admins can clear it. Currently `form.external_booking_url || null` correctly maps empty string to null, but backend admin_update_item filters out None keys — so a null send won't unset an existing URL. Either use $unset when null is sent, or send an empty string and adjust backend to treat empty string as clear.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/admin.py — home-slides literal routes correctly registered before /admin/{kind} catch-all (lines 507-538 vs 549+). Route-shadow test passes.
HomeHeroCarousel picks Math.floor(Math.random()*len) as start index — randomized start confirmed working. Auto-advance interval + prev/next + dots all functional.
Tours.jsx correctly gates external link on `t.external_booking_url` truthiness and sets rel='noopener noreferrer' — no XSS/tabnabbing concern.
CatalogPanel useEffect `alive` guard + eager setItems([]) on kind change resolves the iteration_13 HIGH race. Verified via rapid click reproduction.
EditModal.jsx: state + save payload include external_booking_url but the corresponding UI input was never rendered. Classic 'wired in JS but not in JSX' oversight.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% — HIGH: EditModal missing external URL input; all other iteration_14 UI flows pass

seed_data_creation: Set blue-lagoon.external_booking_url = https://www.bluelagoonisland.com/ during tests (matches main agent's pre-existing state). No leftover test slides — created slide is deleted at end of CRUD test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent adds the missing <F> field for edit-external-url in EditModal.jsx (tours branch only), re-run the frontend E2E script and verify: (a) input renders with current value 'https://www.bluelagoonisland.com/' when editing blue-lagoon, (b) save with empty value clears the URL and /tours no longer shows external link, (c) save with new URL persists. Backend already supports this — no backend change required unless main agent wants explicit unset semantics.
rca of the issue: EditModal.jsx has form state initialization for external_booking_url (line 29) and the save payload correctly includes it for the tours kind (line 63), but no JSX <F> field was added to actually collect the value. Root cause: form field JSX section (lines 100-107) was not updated alongside the state/payload wiring. Fix: add `<F l="Official booking URL" v={form.external_booking_url} on={(v)=>setForm({...form, external_booking_url:v})} testid="edit-external-url" />` in the tours branch of the form (e.g., a new row below the image URL field or inside the 2-col grid guarded by `!isRental && !isTaxi`).
